newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIAN-GREEK TELECOM COMPANY POSTPONES MEETING.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIAN-GREEK TELECOM COMPANY POSTPONES MEETING.

text.p: Bulfon AD, a joint venture of the state Bulgarian Telecommunications Company (BTC) and Greece's private Intracom, has postponed a shareholders meeting scheduled for Friday.
BTC chief Mihail Danov told a news conference on Friday that the meeting had been postponed at the request of the Greek side. He did not elaborate.
BTC and Intracom signed the joint venture deal in September last year in Sofia. Bulgarian media have criticised the fact that BTC has 32 percent and Intracom 68 percent of the venture.
